PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'changed=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.java" "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.js" 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null); printf "%s\n" "$changed" | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *api.ts|*generated*) continue;; esac; lines=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d " "); if [ "$lines" -gt 100 ]; then echo "FILE_SIZE_VIOLATION: $f has $lines lines (cap=100)"; fi; done; exit 0'
